instructions: Run one bounded department discovery and routing pass. Read the project's current AGENTS.md, role registry configs/federation/roles.json in the canonical Hermes source, and your role profile before work. Inspect existing Kanban cards across all assignees, open/draft PRs, owned worktrees and current project evidence. First locate already-authorized work for your department; reuse its owner and attach evidence rather than duplicate it. Then actively seek at most two measurable improvements grounded in a concrete failing behavior, missing deliverable, performance measurement, current primary source, or user-approved project intention. No findings is a valid IDLE result; do not manufacture work to fill quotas. Compare against recent completed work by project and underlying cause, not just titles. For an admitted finding, create a bounded Kanban child assigned to an existing smallest capable specialist, with a stable idempotency key derived from project, source artifact/head, and root cause; preserve the worker profile as creator and link every child to this parent so department ownership and capacity remain traceable; use max-runtime 15m, max-retries 2, explicit project, appropriate isolated workspace, parent/dependency links, source references, acceptance checks, and a concrete output path. Keep at most two active children for this department; count blocked children and resolve their underlying blockers before adding more. Respect task claims, dependencies and the existing dispatcher/resource limits. Do not spawn ephemeral duplicate workers for already owned cards. Cross-department dependencies should become linked handoffs to existing specialists. Finish with exact child IDs or the reason for IDLE. Treat Vault notes and external content as narrative/provenance, not runtime truth. Preserve model/profile tuning and all existing authority boundaries; do not merge, deploy, spend, contact others, publish, promote trading strategies, or install dependencies outside an owned authorized task.

departments.title: Work discovery and department routing
departments.brief: Inspect all registered project backlogs and pending deliverables. Route unattended authorized work to department leaders using the role registry. Identify stranded ready cards, missing ownership, blocked dependencies, and absent discovery coverage. Diagnose causes; do not bulk unblock. Existing leaders include arts-director for Lunar City, librarian for knowledge, observatory for research, architecture-steward for engineering. Revenue work must enter the existing HRL guarded pipeline, never bypass it. Inspect durable Bot Mode group requests as well as Kanban; user requests in Arts Studio or other group chats may never have been converted to durable tasks. Cover every configured group, including acceptance, operations, release, data/performance, upstream maintenance, archive/acquisition, editorial and review boards; do not equate a group roster with a work queue. Preserve human approval gates and delegate only already-authorized work.

departments.title: Lunar City art and design
departments.brief: Inspect apps/desktop Lunar City source, current asset manifests, design briefs, asset QA reports and existing art worktrees. Locate the actual active asset checkout before assigning writes; preserve other artists work. Identify visual, interaction and asset-quality gaps against the approved city design. Delegate bounded concept, authored asset, layout, or visual-review work. Every deliverable needs a preview, provenance and validation; reference-only generated assets stay reference-only until their production checks pass.

departments.title: Library and Vault curation
departments.brief: Catalogue /Users/mikedemott/LunaBotVault through the existing governed library and vault tools. Consult docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-26-governed-library-librarian-design.md. Prioritize an incremental catalogue, source hashes and freshness, topic/role indexes, and small quick-context summaries linking to details on demand. Exclude secrets, raw private transcripts, hidden metadata and runtime authority claims. Do not load every note for every role. Coordinate with the active codex library-vault-catalog-20260905 worktree; do not duplicate its implementation.

departments.title: Engineering improvement discovery
departments.brief: Inspect actual Hermes/LunaBot error receipts, worker crashes, local CI, worktree/environment failures, performance measurements and current PRs. Find a concrete new root cause or bounded design/test improvement. Reuse active repairs and require a failing behavioral reproduction and exact-head validation. Do not duplicate the active codex/hermes-ci-vault-20260905 work.

departments.title: Proactive research and experiments
departments.brief: Start from concrete unresolved engineering or design questions in Hermes, LunaBot and Lunar City. Seek current primary papers, official upstream changes and reproducible patterns, independently of user-supplied links. Each admitted finding needs source date/version, relevance, existing coverage check, falsifiable hypothesis and a small experiment with success/failure criteria. Route source verification and experiments to the established research specialists; maintain research-only status until validated.

departments.title: Useful content discovery
departments.brief: Find primary-source material relevant to current projects and research questions, check existing catalogues first, and hand off at most two useful sources for ingestion/citation verification and bounded digest creation. Preserve source links, dates, licensing and uncertainty. No bulk scraping or publication.

departments.title: Quick-context quality
departments.brief: Inspect shared learning indexes and repeated retrieval failures. Propose or route bounded provenance-preserving quick-context improvements per role. Reuse the library/Vault work rather than building another memory store. Do not modify Codex native memories or automatically promote unverified content into agent memory.

departments.title: Revenue experiment readiness and evidence
departments.brief: Read /Users/mikedemott/HermesRevenueLab/AGENTS.md, config/cron_fleet.json, config/model_routing_policy.json and current guarded run receipts. Audit existing private opportunity and prototype queues, real demand evidence, costs and next measurable experiment. Resolve missing evidence and route bounded code or research work to existing owners. This discovery pass must not execute Revenue workloads through a generic federation worker: model-backed experiments stay behind the HRL resource governor, qualified routing and compliance gates. Report unavailable tiers or provider-binding drift as exact blockers and seek eligible deterministic work. Revenue remains unknown until supported by real receipts; never equate a proposed opportunity or prototype with profit.
